title: 微软如何解释短期调整与长期投入（2023）
topic: 微软如何解释短期调整与长期投入（2023）

source.title: Subject: Focusing on our short- and long-term opportunity - The Official Microsoft Blog
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 原文出自 Microsoft 微软 公开资料。
paragraphs: Satya Nadella shared the below communication today with Microsoft employees.

We’re living through times of significant change, and as I meet with customers and partners, a few things are clear. First, as we saw customers accelerate their digital spend during the pandemic, we’re now seeing them optimize their digital spend to do more with less. We’re also seeing organizations in every industry and geography exercise caution as some parts of the world are in a recession and other parts are anticipating one. At the same time, the next major wave of computing is being born with advances in AI, as we’re turning the world’s most advanced models into a new computing platform.

This is the context in which we as a company must strive to deliver results on an ongoing basis, while investing in our long-term opportunity. I’m confident that Microsoft will emerge from this stronger and more competitive, but it requires us to take actions grounded in three priorities.

First, we will align our cost structure with our revenue and where we see customer demand. Today, we are making changes that will result in the reduction of our overall workforce by 10,000 jobs through the end of FY23 Q3. This represents less than 5 percent of our total employee base, with some notifications happening today. It’s important to note that while we are eliminating roles in some areas, we will continue to hire in key strategic areas. We know this is a challenging time for each person impacted. The senior leadership team and I are committed that as we go through this process, we will do so in the most thoughtful and transparent way possible.
translations: 萨提亚·纳德拉今天向微软员工分享了以下信息。
我们正经历着重大变革时期，当我与客户和合作伙伴会面时，有几件事很明确。首先，正如我们在疫情期间看到客户加速数字支出，现在我们看到他们优化数字支出，以用更少的资源做更多的事情。我们还看到各行各业的组织都在保持谨慎，因为世界某些地区正处于经济衰退，而其他地区则预期会出现经济衰退。与此同时，随着人工智能的进步，下一波主要的计算浪潮正在诞生，因为我们正在将世界上最先进的模型转化为一个新的计算平台。
在这样的背景下，公司必须持续交付成果，同时投资于长期发展机会。我相信微软会因此变得更强、更具竞争力，但我们需要围绕三项优先事项采取行动。
首先，我们会调整成本结构，使其与营收水平和客户需求相匹配。今天宣布的调整将在 2023 财年第三季度末前减少 10,000 个岗位，不到员工总数的 5%；部分受影响员工今天会收到通知。虽然我们会在一些领域缩减岗位，但仍会在关键战略领域继续招聘。我们知道这对每位受影响的员工都很艰难。我和高级领导团队承诺，会尽可能周全、透明地推进整个过程。
fullTextParagraphs: Satya Nadella shared the below communication today with Microsoft employees.

We’re living through times of significant change, and as I meet with customers and partners, a few things are clear. First, as we saw customers accelerate their digital spend during the pandemic, we’re now seeing them optimize their digital spend to do more with less. We’re also seeing organizations in every industry and geography exercise caution as some parts of the world are in a recession and other parts are anticipating one. At the same time, the next major wave of computing is being born with advances in AI, as we’re turning the world’s most advanced models into a new computing platform.

This is the context in which we as a company must strive to deliver results on an ongoing basis, while investing in our long-term opportunity. I’m confident that Microsoft will emerge from this stronger and more competitive, but it requires us to take actions grounded in three priorities.

First, we will align our cost structure with our revenue and where we see customer demand. Today, we are making changes that will result in the reduction of our overall workforce by 10,000 jobs through the end of FY23 Q3. This represents less than 5 percent of our total employee base, with some notifications happening today. It’s important to note that while we are eliminating roles in some areas, we will continue to hire in key strategic areas. We know this is a challenging time for each person impacted. The senior leadership team and I are committed that as we go through this process, we will do so in the most thoughtful and transparent way possible.

Second, we will continue to invest in strategic areas for our future, meaning we are allocating both our capital and talent to areas of secular growth and long-term competitiveness for the company, while divesting in other areas. These are the kinds of hard choices we have made throughout our 47-year history to remain a consequential company in this industry that is unforgiving to anyone who doesn’t adapt to platform shifts. As such, we are taking a $1.2 billion charge in Q2 related to severance costs, changes to our hardware portfolio, and the cost of lease consolidation as we create higher density across our workspaces.

And third, we will treat our people with dignity and respect, and act transparently. These decisions are difficult, but necessary. They are especially difficult because they impact people and people’s lives – our colleagues and friends. We are committed to ensuring all those whose roles are eliminated have our full support during these transitions. U.S.-benefit-eligible employees will receive a variety of benefits, including above-market severance pay, continuing healthcare coverage for six months, continued vesting of stock awards for six months, career transition services, and 60 days’ notice prior to termination, regardless of whether such notice is legally required. Benefits for employees outside the U.S. will align with the employment laws in each country.

When I think about this moment in time, the start of 2023, it’s showtime – for our industry and for Microsoft. As a company, our success must be aligned to the world’s success. That means every one of us and every team across the company must raise the bar and perform better than the competition to deliver meaningful innovation that customers, communities, and countries can truly benefit from. If we deliver on this, we will emerge stronger and thrive long into the future; it’s as simple as that.

I want to extend my deepest thanks and gratitude to everyone who has contributed to Microsoft up to this point and to all of you who will continue to contribute as we chart our path ahead. Thank you for the focus, dedication, and resilience you demonstrate for Microsoft and our customers and partners each day.

notes.phrase: optimize their digital spend to do more with less
notes.meaning: 优化数字支出以用更少的资源做更多的事
notes.explain: 这个短语描述了企业在经济不确定时期采取的效率提升策略，强调在保持或提高产出的同时减少资源投入
notes.example: During the economic downturn, the company optimized its marketing spend to do more with less, focusing on high-ROI channels.

notes.meaning: 投资于我们的长期机会
notes.explain: 这个短语表明企业在进行短期调整的同时，仍然关注并投入资源于具有长期发展潜力的领域
notes.example: While cutting costs in non-core areas, the firm continues investing in its long-term opportunity in renewable energy technology.

notes.phrase: align our cost structure with our revenue
notes.meaning: 使我们的成本结构与我们收入保持一致
notes.explain: 这个短语描述了企业根据收入变化调整支出的财务策略，确保成本与业务规模相匹配
notes.example: The CEO announced that the company will align its cost structure with its revenue to maintain profitability during the market transition.

notes.meaning: 基于三项优先事项的行动
notes.explain: 这个短语表示企业的决策和行动是基于明确的优先级排序，确保资源分配到最关键的方向
notes.example: Our transformation strategy is grounded in three priorities: customer focus, operational excellence, and sustainable growth.

scenario.title: Explain why Microsoft stressed both discipline and investment
english: A colleague asks how Microsoft could be reducing costs while continuing to invest in future opportunities in January 2023.
You summarize two developments Nadella described: customers were optimizing digital spending, while advances in AI were creating a new computing platform.
You explain why the message called for delivering results while investing in the long-term opportunity.
chinese: 一位同事问，微软在 2023 年 1 月为什么一边控制成本，一边继续投入未来机会。
你概括 Nadella 提到的两项变化：客户在优化数字支出，AI 进展则带来新的计算平台。
你说明邮件为何要求公司既要持续交付，也要投资长期机会。

firstAttempt.prompt: 同事问微软 2023 年员工信为什么同时强调控制支出和长期投入。请用英文概括客户支出变化，以及信中提到的 AI 机会。
firstAttempt.sample: Customers were looking to optimize digital spending and do more with less, so Microsoft emphasized discipline. The message also described AI as a major computing shift and said the company would keep investing in that opportunity.
firstAttempt.rationale: 回答呈现原信中的两股力量：客户更加谨慎，同时 AI 带来新的长期机会。

words.example: The company is reallocating its digital spend to focus on AI-powered customer engagement tools.
words.translation: 公司正在重新分配其数字支出，专注于人工智能驱动的客户参与工具。
words.note: 在商业语境中，digital spend通常指企业在数字技术、营销和运营方面的投资总额

words.example: The pandemic accelerated the adoption of remote work technologies across industries.
words.translation: 疫情加速了各行业对远程工作技术的采用。
words.note: accelerate常用于描述进程、发展或变化的加快，强调速度的提升

words.example: The new software helps businesses optimize their supply chain operations for maximum efficiency.
words.translation: 这款新软件帮助企业优化供应链运营，实现最高效率。
words.note: optimize强调通过调整或改进使某事物达到最佳状态或效果

words.example: Given the market volatility, investors are advised to exercise caution when making new commitments.
words.translation: 鉴于市场波动，投资者在做出新承诺时应谨慎行事。
words.note: caution在商业语境中常指面对不确定风险时采取的保守态度

words.example: Our strategic decisions are grounded in comprehensive market research and customer feedback.
words.translation: 我们的战略决策基于全面的市场研究和客户反馈。
words.note: grounded表示某事物有坚实的基础或依据，而非凭空想象

words.example: The management team has identified three key priorities for the upcoming fiscal year.
words.translation: 管理团队已确定了下一个财政年度的三个关键优先事项。
words.note: priorities指在资源分配和决策过程中需要优先考虑的事项

structure.original: We’re living through times of significant change, and as I meet with customers and partners, a few things are clear.
analysis: We're living through times of significant change 是现在进行时态的主句，表示'我们正经历着重大变革时期'，其中living through是动词短语，times of significant change是名词短语作宾语
and as I meet with customers and partners 是由and连接的并列从句，as引导时间状语从句，表示'当我与客户和合作伙伴会面时'
a few things are clear 是主句，表示'一些事情变得清晰明了'，其中a few things是主语，are clear是系表结构
structure.transfer: As customer spending changes, we are reviewing costs and choosing which new tools to invest in.

rewrite.bad: We should move 20% of the ad budget to SEO. That is the only way to spend less.
rewrite.good: Customers were looking to optimize digital spending and do more with less, so Microsoft emphasized discipline. The message also described AI as a major computing shift and said the company would keep investing in that opportunity.
rewrite.translation: 客户希望优化数字支出、用更少资源做更多事，因此微软强调保持纪律。信中也把 AI 描述为重要的计算变革，并表示公司会继续投入这一机会。
rewrite.pattern: The message says customers were [changing their spending], while the company would [maintain investment in an opportunity].

cloze.prompt: Customers are trying to get more ___ from their digital spending.
cloze.why: get more value from 表示提高已有支出的回报。

cloze.prompt: We need to be ___ about current spending.
cloze.why: disciplined about spending 表示严格管理当前投入。

cloze.prompt: The message describes AI as a long-term opportunity worth ___ in.
cloze.why: worth 后接动名词；说明长期投入的理由。

dictation.text: Sarah, a marketing manager, needed to reduce her department's digital advertising budget by 30% for the next quarter while maintaining campaign performance.
dictation.why: 听清句中的工作任务、动作和时间信息。

dictation.text: Her team argued that cutting spend would hurt long-term brand visibility, but finance insisted on immediate cost reductions due to declining revenue.
dictation.why: 听清句中的工作任务、动作和时间信息。

translationPractice.prompt: 客户希望从数字化支出中获得更大价值。
translationPractice.answer: Customers are trying to get more value from their digital spending.
translationPractice.why: 本句练习“get more value from digital spending”在说明客户希望提高数字支出的回报时的用法。

translationPractice.prompt: 客户希望提高数字支出的价值，因此我们需要保持投入纪律。
translationPractice.answer: Customers are trying to get more value from their digital spending, so we need to be disciplined.
translationPractice.why: 本句练习“we need to be disciplined”在说明当前仍需严格管理资源时的用法。

choice.prompt: 同事问微软 2023 年员工信为什么同时强调控制支出和长期投入。请用英文概括客户支出变化，以及信中提到的 AI 机会。
options: The message describes customers optimizing digital spending while AI creates a new computing opportunity that Microsoft intends to pursue.

Customers were looking to optimize digital spending and do more with less, so Microsoft emphasized discipline. The message also described AI as a major computing shift and said the company would keep investing in that opportunity.
The message says Microsoft would stop investing in AI until customers increased their digital budgets.
choice.why: 回答呈现原信中的两股力量：客户更加谨慎，同时 AI 带来新的长期机会。

output.prompt: 同事问，为什么公司一边要求团队提高效率，一边仍投资新技术。请用英文说明客户当前的支出环境和长期技术机会可以同时存在。
output.sample: Customers are trying to get more value from their digital spending, so we need to be disciplined. At the same time, the message describes AI as a long-term opportunity worth investing in.
check: 是否说明客户支出趋于谨慎？
是否准确表达长期技术机会？
是否体现短期纪律与长期投入并存？

credits.audio: 美式英语合成朗读，非公司员工原声。
